newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering pay settlements edge higher.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering pay settlements edge higher.

text.p: The average level of UK engineering pay settlements rose to 3.11 percent in the three months to October from 3.06 percent in the three months to September, the Engineering Employers' Federation (EEF) said.

"Although the three-month average is just above three percent, 61 percent of all reported settlements were three percent or less. Thirty percent were in the 3.01 to 4.0 percent range," the EEF said in its November pay bulletin.
The average three-month level of settlements was 3.40 percent in the same period last year. The survey said October was the first month in nearly three years in which no pay freeze had been reported.
"We are encouraged to see that pay settlements in the industry are stable at three percent," EEF employment affairs head David Yeandle said.
"We trust this prudent approach on behalf of employers and employees will prevent a pay spiral following the rise in RPI and the phased abolition of tax relief on profit-related pay in the budget."
